recap.text: Miriam and Prepotente destroy generators to stop ghouls. Carl's group arrives and drops a boss into the abyss that Prepotente spent two hours debuffing. Miriam hits the top of Prepotente's head with her staff until he apologizes.

Miriam sings karaoke on a show with Katia. While she is gone, Prepotente has a panic attack, goes berserk, and runs off. Miriam looks for her boy and is attacked and cursed. A vegan before the event, Miriam is now a vampire.

Miriam becomes a vampire and helps Bianca haul Carl out of the city in a cart. She leads Prepotente south along a caravan road toward an Ursine settlement. After Prepotente kills an elite in a pink feathered necklace, he is paralysed for thirty-five hours with his arm around Miriam's waist. Miriam waits for the sun to kill her so Prepotente can heal from the Ring of Divine Suffering.

Bianca burns a guildmaster while Miriam and Pony enter through a hidden door. Miriam rubs a salve into Pony's arm and threatens her with a knife. A file records that Miriam died on the sixth floor from a programme called Blood Hunter. Prepotente kills most of the Naga army as payment for her.

beats.headline: Same plan, other side of the Tangle
beats.text: We worked it out some time ago: the ghouls keep coming while the generators stand, so the generators have to go, every one of them. We have been taking them from this side of the knot, Prepotente and I, at his pace, which is patient. He puts debuffs on a thing for hours and waits for it to fall. Now Carl's group arrives from the far side with the same plan, and they have just dropped into the abyss the boss my boy was two hours from finishing. He threatens them for it. I take my staff to the top of his head until he apologises, and I tell them all that two groups landing on the same plan only means the plan is good.
beats.gist: Miriam Dom tells Carl's group that two groups landing on the same plan means the plan is good.

beats.headline: Karaoke, and then the curse
beats.text: They put me on a show with Katia and have the two of us sing karaoke. While I am gone, Prepotente has a panic attack and goes berserk and runs off. When I get back I go looking for my boy, and that is when something attacks me and curses me. I was a vegan before all this. The curse has made me a vampire, and I understand the people who chose it for me thought that was very funny.
beats.gist: Miriam Dom sings karaoke with Katia while Prepotente has a panic attack and runs off.

beats.headline: A vampire now
beats.text: I am a vampire now, and the leaderboard says so. It changes a great many things. It has not changed how I feel about my boy, which is the part I was afraid of. We bring Carl out of the city in the back of a cart, with Bianca hauling it, and while he comes round the cat tells him what Mordecai has said: the Ring of Divine Suffering is addictive. I hope Carl listens. Men with a tool that works rarely do.
beats.gist: Miriam Dom becomes a vampire, and Bianca hauls Carl out of the city in a cart.

beats.headline: The caravan road is clear
beats.text: We are on the main road south, sweetie, following the path of the caravans, and there are very few mobs about. The bodyguards on the caravans cast anti-trap spells as they travel, so even the traps made for crawlers are disarmed. We plan to cross the river soon and disappear into the jungle. Yes, there is a town near the bridge, a very big one, a large Ursine settlement on the far side, forty kilometres from Carl. It is where we started. Be careful there. They are very peculiar. We have to put Bianca away when we enter.
beats.gist: Miriam Dom follows the caravan road south toward a large Ursine settlement forty kilometres from Carl.

beats.headline: Trapped under his arm
beats.text: The elite is dead and the quest is done. My boy killed him and was paralysed doing it, and the elite only died a few minutes ago, when the sun set. The paralysis was thirty-five hours; fifteen remain. His arm is around my waist, and if any part of him breaks, even his thumb, he will shatter. Bianca is in a carrier in his inventory. Through the daylight I alternated Revive and blood potions, and I have a handful left. I have asked for help for hours. The system would not let my messages reach Carl.
beats.gist: Miriam Dom uses Revive and blood potions on a paralyzed boy while Bianca stays in a carrier.

beats.headline: It is spreading through the forest
beats.text: Carl asks whether we fought a giant dinosaur in a pink feathered necklace. We did. She carried a wand. I almost killed her, and then something happened and she escaped. He thinks I infected her. Yes. I know. Many of the dinosaurs in this area are vampires now, and it is spreading quickly. They are weak for the first few days, if they survive, and then they grow strong. It was part of the elite's story. He died before it could be stopped. You must help me.
beats.gist: Carl fought Miriam Dom, a dinosaur in a pink feathered necklace with a wand, who escaped.

beats.headline: Marked by his ring, waiting for the sun
beats.text: Carl and Donut have found us. Prepotente is paralysed, with his arm still around my waist. In the last fight his Ring of Divine Suffering marked me. That is how it works: while I live, he cannot heal. And I am the head of this, so when I go, everyone it has touched is cured. I have asked Carl to do it before the paralysis wears off. He has said no. So we sit, and we wait for the sun.
beats.gist: Miriam Dom asks Carl to kill her before Prepotente's paralysis wears off.

beats.headline: Dust at sunrise
beats.text: Crawler Miriam Dom has been eliminated in a forest clearing on the sixth floor. Cause of death: sunlight, which she waited for. She had summoned the man to kill her. He declined, and stood watch with her instead. She died with her head on Prepotente's frozen shoulder, saying "my beautiful boy" twice. Bounty unclaimed: 300,000 gold.
beats.gist: Crawler Miriam Dom is eliminated by sunlight in a forest clearing on the sixth floor.

beats.headline: A salve for the guildmaster
beats.text: Pony will not stand for what they have done, and there are guards down in the hall, and Bianca melting another. We go through a hidden door into a little guild, and Bianca burns the guildmaster before I can stop her. Pony, give me a salve. I ask what kind of creature she is, and rub it into her arm myself. She was a crawler once. She says she hopes we will not threaten her, because if we do, she might be forced to give us information. I thank her with a hand on her shoulder, and take out a knife.
beats.gist: Bianca burns a guildmaster, and a crawler rubs a salve into Miriam Dom's arm.

beats.headline: Answered for
beats.text: Update to the file of Crawler Miriam Dom, deceased on the sixth floor, cause of death a programme called Blood Hunter, filed under entertainment. From the ninth: most of the Naga army is dead as well. That was Prepotente, and he did it as payment for her, all of it, at a rate he set himself. If you were hoping the goat would grieve quietly, crawler, you have not been paying attention.
beats.gist: Miriam Dom dies on the sixth floor from a programme called Blood Hunter.
